prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 对照 · 同一文本的两种角色 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标名称" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 122px
  col 2: header "年度经营目标" · longest unbreakable word 36px · one-line width 109px
  col 3: header "客户满意度提升" · longest unbreakable word 33px · one-line width 122px
  col 4: header "研发效能改进" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 157px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对照三项指标在年度经营目标、客户满意度提升和研发效能改进三种角色下的内容，突出各指标对应的目标或改进内容。","reading":"先按首列定位指标，再横向查找该行的有效内容；纵向扫描各角色列时，读者可比较对应条目，并快速识别破折号所表示的空项。","groups":["第2至第4列都是角色或目标列，应保持相近的视觉权重；其中第4列内容较长，需要更多宽度。","首列是行标题，与上方列标题共同构成查找路径，需要便于快速辨认。"],"keep_intact":["百分比、数字及其单位或符号，例如25%和50。","缩写及其相邻数字，例如NPS和50。","破折号应独立且清晰可见。"],"may_wrap":["较长的中文列标题和行标题可在词语边界自然换行。","目标或改进内容中的中文短语可自然换行；若同一行已有较高单元格，其他单元格的换行可利用该行高度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [140, 105, 112, 122] · table 480×264px · row heights [66, 66, 66, 66] · column headers wrapped 3/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [130, 105, 125, 119] · table 480×264px · row heights [66, 66, 66, 66] · column headers wrapped 3/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [143, 100, 115, 121] · table 480×264px · row heights [66, 66, 66, 66] · column headers wrapped 3/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"三列角色的宽度较接近，数值和破折号清楚，数据行高度一致，横向查找容易。","problems":"“客户满意度提升”作为行标题时末字单独换到第二行，辨认节奏被打断；第三、四列表头也分别留下较短的尾行。","cause":"首列140px略不足以容纳该行标题；第三列112px和第四列122px不足以完整容纳各自表头。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"第三列比r2A更宽，角色列之间仍有清晰的分隔；数值、单位和破折号保持完整。","problems":"首列行标题仍有单字尾行，第三列表头同样留下单字尾行，视觉上比r2A更零碎；第四列表头也换行。","cause":"首列130px不足以容纳最长行标题；第三列125px允许表头排入更多字，却仍不足以排完整个标题；第四列119px不足以容纳完整表头。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"首列143px使三个行标题均保持单行，定位行更顺畅；三列角色仍有相近的视觉权重，数值和破折号完整。","problems":"三个角色表头均换行，其中第四列表头的末字单独成行；第二列目标内容也分成两行。","cause":"第二列100px、第三列115px和第四列121px都不足以完整容纳各自表头；第二列内容宽度也不足以让“营收增长 25%”同排。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r3A","widths":[143,95,118,123],"change":"以r2C为基础，保留首列单行行标题，将少量宽度从第二列移给第三、四列，尝试改善角色表头的断行，同时保持角色列的视觉权重接近。"},{"name":"r3B","widths":[130,90,140,119],"change":"尝试优先完整显示最长的第三列表头；缩窄第二列并接受首列较长行标题换行，检验更清晰的列标题层级是否足以抵消行标题断行。"}]}
